answer: One defence is Proof of unique device bootloader unlock status: a phone whose bootloader stayed locked its whole life, and the echo of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a phone whose bootloader stayed locked its whole life is something they already have; the signal falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The vine grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
